prompts: Use case: ui-mockup. Create polished high fidelity design proposal for existing iOS metronome app. Reference image is STYLE REFERENCE only: preserve warm ivory vintage-modern hardware keys, subtle fine material grain, warm graphite typography, restrained bevels and shadows, recessed pale grey LCD/list surfaces. Not glossy, not yellow, no excessive shadows, no marketing slogans. All UI Chinese, crisp typography. Flat front-on app screens without bulky phone mockup frames. Status bars 6:27 full battery/network. Clear whitespace and quiet hierarchy. Render landscape large readable design board. Three equal portrait app panels side by side, external captions above panels: '设置 · 现场模式', '全部歌单', '一张歌单'. Left panel is a focused enlarged Settings section: header 设置 with X key, section 03 现场模式, three equal cream raised square tiles horizontally. Icons are a little taped stage setlist paper, cassette collection, dual foot pedal. Labels 歌单 / 歌曲库 / 踏板. Optical icon+label grouping centered: generous top padding, paper moved down and close to label, same baseline labels. Below collapsed 演出前准备 chevron and quiet bottom 96 BPM plus play key. Center panel all setlists: header 歌单 and X only, no edit. Recessed content-sized list of TWO rows: 2026 湾区巡演 subtitle 3 首, 周六排练 subtitle 5 首. Each row has right-facing chevron and quiet drag grip, rows separated by thin divider, not individual raised buttons. Under container one raised '+ 新建歌单' button. NO Saved songs, no song library shortcut, no bottom transport. Right panel a setlist detail: top slim control row [back chevron key] small context 歌单 on left, [编辑] key and X key on right. On its OWN full-width line below controls, large name '2026 湾区巡演' all visible; then small '3 首'. Then raised dark '从第一首开始' key. Recessed list with rows 'Gossip' / '男孩别哭' / '夜来香', secondary 4/4 and quarter note, right aligned 140 BPM / 85 BPM / 96 BPM and chevrons. Each song is plain row in shared recessed surface not a separate raised button. Below list single raised '+ 添加歌曲'. Keep entire screens coherent. No annotations inside UI. No giant wasted empty recessed region.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create polished high fidelity design proposal for existing iOS metronome app. Reference image is STYLE REFERENCE only: preserve warm ivory vintage-modern hardware keys, subtle fine material grain, warm graphite typography, restrained bevels and shadows, recessed pale grey LCD/list surfaces. Not glossy, not yellow, no excessive shadows, no marketing slogans. All UI Chinese, crisp typography. Flat front-on app screens without bulky phone mockup frames. Status bars 6:27 full battery/network. Clear whitespace and quiet hierarchy. Render landscape large readable design board. Two equal portrait screens side by side, outside captions '歌单内演出' and '单曲演出'. Both screens have large recessed LCD with giant black beat numeral 1, accent > above and four tiny beat position dots along bottom, first filled double ring. Beat LCD is dominant 45% of screen, stylistically identical to home metronome recessed warm grey screen. LEFT top navigation control row back key with small label 歌曲列表, right 编辑 key and X key. BELOW controls a separate full-width line '2026 湾区巡演' medium grey fully visible, NO count parentheses. Next line song title 男孩别哭 bold and small 第 2 首 aligned right. Next single metadata row '85 BPM · 4/4 · ♩' and small raised 备注 key at right. Then giant beat screen. Below screen one horizontal row: small previous icon key and wide next key with small 下一首, bold 夜来香, 96 BPM, next-track icon. Bottom single row raised 轻点定速 key and larger charcoal stop-square key. RIGHT standalone performance: top controls back key with small label 歌曲库, right 编辑 key and X key. Song title 'Wonderwall' full-width large on own line below. NO setlist context, NO ordinal, NO total song count. Metadata one line '90 BPM · 4/4 · ♩' plus 备注 key. Larger giant beat LCD uses space saved by absence of previous/next controls. Bottom only 轻点定速 and charcoal stop key in one row. NO previous/next controls whatsoever in standalone screen. Consistent alignments, margins and typography between both; avoid redundant headings or tips. Buttons have actual cream hardware surfaces. Full song title must never compete horizontally with toolbar buttons.
